features.reason: The membership directory replaces the old user search with a smaller feature set.
features.restore: Restore multi-value filter operators, presets, URL state, contact search policy, and CSV export for the selected band.
features.verification: Test filter combinations, permission restrictions, pagination, URL round trips, and exported rows; exercise the built directory.

features.reason: The basic membership profile no longer routes through the complete user-detail workflow.
features.restore: Restore reachable profile tabs, attendance, credits, wiki contributions, permitted account controls, and profile activity recording with explicit ownership.
features.verification: Test tab URLs, self/admin/outsider permissions and context switches; exercise each restored profile workflow in the built app.

features.reason: Single-band Role administration cannot execute against GlobalRole and BandRole.
features.restore: Restore role and permission editors, designations, account role assignment and continuity safeguards using GlobalRole/BandRole; never restore User.role.
features.verification: Adapt the preserved authorization and command tests; verify atomic designations, protected grants, fresh authorization, auditing and browser editors.

features.reason: The legacy person-level merge policies have no complete cross-band replacement.
features.restore: Restore candidate search, preview, confirmation, credential/session handling and transactional merging across all owned records and memberships.
features.verification: Adapt policy, picker, authorization and native transaction tests, including stale previews, audit rollback, concurrency and idempotency; exercise the merge dialog.

features.reason: Account dependency analysis and comparison were disabled with the legacy merge readers.
features.restore: Restore authorized dependency reports, risk summaries and two-account comparison with explicit account and band ownership.
features.verification: Test dependency counts, visibility, comparison, merged/deleted accounts and the built analysis tab.

features.reason: Startup intentionally omits legacy domain readers and the home page hides their content.
features.restore: Restore relevant events, calendar, announcements/wiki content, custom navigation and required reference catalogs with authorized band-scoped reads.
features.verification: Adapt dashboard transport specifications and add native snapshots plus built-browser checks for two bands, permission revocation and context switches.

features.reason: The application shell no longer mounts MainSiteSearch.
features.restore: Restore shell search with authorized band-scoped readers, selected-band links and context-safe cached results.
features.verification: Test cross-domain results, visibility, keyboard navigation and band switches; exercise shell search in the built app.

features.reason: LocalizedMarkdown preserves rendering but its inline editor was removed.
features.restore: Restore edit, cancel, save, save-and-close, feedback and refresh through explicit localized-string scope and locale.
features.verification: Test edit authorization, locale/band targeting, intentional blanks, cancellation, failed saves and presentation refresh; exercise the inline editor.

features.reason: Old setting readers, writers and tests were removed while typed settings replaced the storage contract.
features.restore: Account for legacy settings and branding editor workflows using typed hives and per-key authorization; preserve scheduling reanchor and cache invalidation semantics.
features.verification: Adapt preserved user/branding/setting authorization specifications and native time-zone tests; verify editor saves and resets in the built app.

features.reason: The song-tag editor replacement dropped its configured help Markdown.
features.restore: Restore edit-song-tag help content through localized Markdown without losing the migrated catalog editor.
features.verification: Verify the configured help is rendered in the selected locale and band alongside the song-tag editor.

features.reason: Legacy demo generators were deleted because they referenced removed models.
features.restore: Account for useful sample users, catalogs, songs/files, events/attendance, wiki and activity generators using target-schema ownership; obtain explicit approval for any retired generator.
features.verification: Run restored generators only against a disposable target-schema database and verify their relationships; never restore automatic production startup backfills.
